ambiguities.aspect: Conditional on ring vs. vibrate_mode-only outputs
readings: The mode selection applies only when ring=1: ringer = ring & ~vibrate_mode, motor = ring & vibrate_mode, so both outputs are 0 when ring=0.
The mode selection is unconditional: ringer = ~vibrate_mode, motor = vibrate_mode, so one output is 1 even when ring=0.
When ring=0, both ringer and motor must be 0.
When ring=0, the outputs are not specified and may be 0, 1, or hold previous values.
